# Product launch — stages

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py from workflow.yaml. -->

Take a verified product to market: confirm gate readiness, define launch strategy and tiers, produce truthful positioning and assets, prepare sales enablement, support and monitoring, execute by tier with rollback criteria, and run a post-launch review.

**Trigger:** A product or major feature has passed build, testing, security, documentation and legal gates and is ready to go to market.
